deviations.event: The pre-existing abstention-dev-v1 validation split was exposed to the executing agent before Candidate-v4 freeze and was used for pre-freeze diagnostic checking.
deviations.impact: That split is permanently disqualified from serving as Candidate-v4 one-time protected validation.
deviations.scientific_contamination_of_candidate_so: POSSIBLE_BY_EXPOSURE; therefore fail-closed protection requires a new post-freeze validation benchmark.
deviations.remediation: Preserve the original preregistration; supersede only its protected-validation source boundary before freeze; freeze Candidate-v4 without further source changes; create and freeze a new mechanism-agnostic non-sealed validation benchmark only after candidate freeze; run it once; never use its result to patch Candidate-v4.

deviations.event: A broad PR changed-filenames metadata query incidentally surfaced the name of a path containing a sealed-final marker.
deviations.impact: No sealed-final payload, cases, labels, values, statistics, or content entered Candidate-v4 design. However, the mission explicitly prohibits listing sealed-final, so the metadata-only exposure must not be hidden or reported as a perfect no-list record.
deviations.remediation: Do not perform any further operation targeting or enumerating sealed-final paths. Preserve this deviation and apply fail-closed interpretation at formal Gate E reassessment.

deviations.event: CI run 31391250893 and Zero-Cost Algorithm Evidence run 31391251086 failed because new benchmark-affecting Python inputs require an explicit benchmark version bump.
deviations.root_cause: freeze_pilot_benchmark.py rejected changed benchmark-affecting inputs while pilot-v0.6 was reused without a new version.
deviations.remediation: Bump pilot lock version explicitly after all current pre-freeze Python changes; preserve failed runs rather than rerunning them as if transient.

claim_boundary: This artifact records deviations rather than curing them. Final Gate E must apply the preregistered fail-closed integrity rules.
